prompt.text: No model and no prompt: made in code from the committed hand-drawn v2 pixel map (assets/source/sprites/shots/missile.v2.sprite.json, w15-PIXMAP1). The interim map was a stretched v1 box, not a redraw, and FLUX never drew this lance-subject cleanly (the s-shots-missile asks); the map is the last name in the v2 interim pool. The redraw is hand-pixelled per art bible v2 § 5.3 — the missile at 12 × 5 with tail fins on the outline rows, a two-pixel nozzle, a three-step tapered exhaust flame and a white nose shoulder capped in outline dark — on v1's exact five colours; this script lays those map rows ×16 nearest on the flat ask key, one solid block per pixel, centred in each cell of the sheet.

notes: shots/missile v2 (2 flicker frames 12x5 native, the fly [0,1] loop, the ground missile; anchor [6,2] keeps the centre; hitFlash false, no @flash sibling). The last name in the v2 interim pool (the era census 118→…→1→0): the interim map was a stretched v1 box — a full 12 × 5 outline rectangle with a three-row body — not a redraw, and FLUX never drew this lance-subject cleanly. The redraw is hand-pixelled per art bible v2 § 5.3 (tail fins on the outline rows, a two-pixel nozzle, a three-step tapered exhaust flame, a white nose shoulder capped in outline dark, the core line whole) and lives as the committed pixel map assets/source/sprites/shots/missile.v2.sprite.json, the design source of truth; the committed art-prompts/v2/code-frames/make_missile.mjs reads its rows and palette from disk and lays them ×16 nearest on the flat ask key (model code, deterministic byte-exact re-run, --check proven). The five colours are exactly the ones the interim map shipped (#2a3a4a, #a0a8b8, #ffffff, #e84818, #f8c030), so the palette-cycle margin is kept by design and nothing new enters the atlas palette; no colour is invented and no step is improvised. No p2 map: the shot ships no @p2 sibling today. The bullet/laser palette law (the ^(bullets|lasers)/ regex) does not cover shots/, so no @palette variants are owed. The design carries its own outline, so the outline pass is off.
